start.welcome: Hi {name}! I'm Pot Bot. I track your FPL league's weekly pot, check Telebirr payments and post the results. I never hold or send money.
web.placeholder: Pot Bot Mini App is coming soon.
common.fplDown: I can't reach FPL right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
common.ownerOnly: Only the league owner can do that.
common.noLeague: This group isn't linked to an FPL league yet. Run /setup first.
setup.groupOnly: Run /setup in your league's group chat, not here.
setup.adminOnly: Only a group admin can run /setup.
setup.usage:
Paste your FPL league ID or standings link, like this:
/setup https://fantasy.premierleague.com/leagues/123456/standings/c

You'll find it on the FPL site: open your league's standings and copy the address.
setup.inviteLink: That's an invite link, which I can't read. Open your league's standings on the FPL site and send me that address instead, or just the number in it: /leagues/123456/standings/c
setup.notFound: I couldn't find FPL classic league {id}. Check the ID and try again.
setup.alreadyLinked: This group is already linked to {name}.
setup.cancelled: Setup cancelled. Run /setup again whenever you're ready.
setup.badGw: The first gameweek must be between GW{first} and GW{next}. Leave it out to start at GW{next}.
setup.noNextGw: There are no gameweeks left to play this season.
setup.working: Loading the season. This can take a moment.
setup.done: {name} is linked. First pot gameweek: GW{gw}.
setup.seasonEmpty: No gameweeks have been played in the bot yet.
setup.seedFreePass: Free pass for GW{gw}: {names} (runner-up in GW{previous}).
setup.joinPrompt: Everyone: tap the button, press Start, and pick your team. I can only message you privately after that.
join.invalid: That link isn't valid any more. Ask your league owner for a new one.
join.none: Every team in {league} has been claimed. If yours is wrong, ask the league owner.
join.taken: Someone just claimed that team. Pick another.
join.success: You're in! You're linked to {team} in {league}.
link.usage: Reply to someone's message with /link <FPL team ID> to link them to that team.
link.notFound: No team with ID {id} in this league.
link.userHasTeam: That person is already linked to another team in this league.
unlink.usage: Use /unlink <FPL team ID> to remove the person linked to that team.
unlink.done: {team} is no longer linked to anyone.
settle.payoutNote: The coordinator sends this by Telebirr. Pot Bot never holds or moves money.
settle.carry: {amount} birr rolls into the next pot.
settle.noWinner: Nobody was eligible to win this gameweek.
settle.waitingForReview: GW{gw} can't settle yet: {count} payment(s) sent before the deadline still need your review.
override.denied: Only the league owner or coordinator can do that.
override.usage:
To correct a score:
/override score <FPL team ID> <gameweek> <points> [transfer cost]

To name the winner:
/override winner <gameweek> <team IDs> [runner <team IDs>]
Separate several team IDs with commas.
override.noGameweek: GW{gw} isn't part of this league.
override.notStarted: GW{gw} hasn't started, so it has no result to correct.
override.noTeam: No team with ID {id} in this league.
override.scoreSaved: Saved: {team} scored {points} with a {cost} point transfer cost in GW{gw}. It will be used when GW{gw} settles.
override.nextLocked: GW{gw} has already started, so its fees and free passes were not changed. Please sort those out by hand.
coordinator.usage: Reply to someone's message with /coordinator to make them the league's coordinator.
rules.invalid: That isn't a valid value for {key}. Send /rules to see the current settings.
rules.saved: {key} is now {value}. Gameweeks that have already started aren't affected.
